CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION feed_api.create_post(p_body_b64 text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'feed_data'
AS $function$
 DECLARE post_id bigint;
 BEGIN
  INSERT INTO feed_data.posts(user_id,body) VALUES(feed_data.writer_id(),decode(p_body_b64,'base64')) RETURNING id INTO post_id;
  RETURN feed_data.post_json(post_id);
 END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION feed_api.detail(p_post_id bigint)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'feed_data'
AS $function$ SELECT feed_data.post_json(p_post_id) $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION feed_api.feed()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'feed_data'
AS $function$
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(feed_data.post_json(p.id) ORDER BY p.created_at DESC,p.id DESC),'[]'::jsonb)
 FROM (SELECT id,created_at FROM feed_data.posts ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 20) p
 $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION feed_api.health()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'feed_data'
AS $function$
 BEGIN PERFORM 1 FROM feed_data.users LIMIT 1; RETURN true; END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION feed_data.codepoints(value bytea)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE STRICT
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$ SELECT count(*) FROM generate_series(0,octet_length(value)-1) n WHERE (get_byte(value,n)&192)<>128 $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION feed_data.post_json(p_id bigint)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'feed_data'
AS $function$
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('id',p.id,'body_b64',encode(p.body,'base64'),'created_at',p.created_at,'author',u.username,
 'like_count',(SELECT count(*) FROM feed_data.likes l WHERE l.post_id=p.id))
 FROM feed_data.posts p JOIN feed_data.users u ON u.id=p.user_id WHERE p.id=p_id
 $function$
